title: UniToolCall: Unifying Tool-Use Representation, Data, and Evaluation for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2604.11557v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Tool-use capability is a fundamental component of LLM agents, enabling them to interact with external systems through structured function calls. However, existing research exhibits inconsistent interaction representations, largely overlooks the structural distribution of tool-use trajectories, and relies on incompatible evaluation benchmarks. We present UniToolCall, a unified framework for tool learning that standardizes the entire pipeline from toolset construction and dataset generation to evaluation. The framework curates a large tool pool of 22k+ tools and constructs a hybrid training corpus of 390k+ instances by combining 10 standardized public datasets with structurally controlled synthetic trajectories. It explicitly models diverse interaction patterns, including single-hop vs. multi-hop and single-turn vs. multi-turn, while capturing both serial and parallel execution structures. translated_title: UniToolCall：为LLM智能体统一工具使用表示、数据与评估
translated_abstract: 工具使用能力是大语言模型（LLM）智能体的基础组成部分，使其能够通过结构化的函数调用与外部系统进行交互。然而，现有研究存在交互表示不一致的问题，在很大程度上忽视了工具使用轨迹的结构分布，并且依赖于互不兼容的评估基准。我们提出了UniToolCall，这是一个统一的工具学习框架，对从工具集构建、数据集生成到评估的整个流程进行了标准化。该框架整理了一个包含22k+工具的大型工具池，并通过将10个标准化公开数据集与结构受控的合成轨迹相结合，构建了包含390k+实例的混合训练语料库。它显式地建模了多样化的交互模式，包括单跳与多跳、单轮与多轮，同时捕捉串行和并行执行结构。为支持连贯的多轮推理，我们……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: UniToolCall提出了一个统一的大语言模型智能体工具学习框架，通过标准化交互表示、构建包含22k+工具和390k+实例的混合训练语料库并显式建模多样化交互模式与执行结构，解决了现有工具使用研究中表示不一致、忽视轨迹结构分布及评估基准互不兼容的问题。
en_tdlr: UniToolCall presents a unified tool learning framework for LLM agents that standardizes tool-use representation, data generation, and evaluation across the entire pipeline, curating a tool pool of 22k+ tools and a hybrid corpus of 390k+ instances while explicitly modeling diverse interaction patterns (single-hop vs. multi-hop, single-turn vs. multi-turn) and both serial and parallel execution structures.
